Plainly, therefore, nothing should be written into a Constitution that is of a temporary, experimental, or questionable nature, or which should fall to the lot of ordinary law-making and the changing convenience of practice. A Constitution is that which is permanent, as far as anything in this world may be permanent.

arxiv-2111-00597.description: Abstract . Model Predictive Control (MPC) is a well-established approach to solve infinite horizon optimal control problems. Since optimization over an infinite time horizon is generally infeasible, MPC determines a suboptimal feedback control by repeatedly solving finite time optimal control problems. arxiv-2212-01385.title: Re-evaluating sample efficiency in de novo molecule generation
arxiv-2212-01385.creator: Morgan Thomas, Noel M. O’Boyle, Andreas Bender, Chris de Graaf
arxiv-2212-01385.description: Abstract De novo molecule generation can suffer from data inefficiency; requiring large amounts of training data or many sampled data points to conduct objective optimization. The latter is a particular disadvantage when combining deep generative models with computationally expensive molecule scoring functions (a.k.a. oracles) commonly used in computer-aided drug design.

arxiv-2311-11478.title: Evidence of Dark Contents in the Center of NGC 6517 2022 Evidence of Dark Contents in the Center of NGC 6517 – References
arxiv-2311-11478.creator: Yi Xie Dejiang Yin Lichun Wang Yujie Lian Liyun Zhang Zhichen Pan
arxiv-2311-11478.description: Abstract Millisecond pulsars can serve as effective probes to investigate the presence of Intermediate-mass Black Holes (IMBHs) within Galactic globular clusters (GCs). Based on the standard structure models for GCs, we conduct simulations to analyze the distributions of pulsar accelerations within the central region of NGC 6517.

arxiv-2311-18064.title: GELDA: A generative language annotation framework to reveal visual biases in datasets
arxiv-2311-18064.creator: Krish Kabra, Kathleen M. Lewis, Guha Balakrishnan
arxiv-2311-18064.description: Abstract Bias analysis is a crucial step in the process of creating fair datasets for training and evaluating computer vision models. The bottleneck in dataset analysis is annotation, which typically requires: (1) specifying a list of attributes relevant to the dataset domain, and (2) classifying each image-attribute pair.

arxiv-2405-16303.title: Extended spin relaxation times of optically addressed telecom defects in silicon carbide
arxiv-2405-16303.creator: Jonghoon Ahn, Christina Wicker, Nolan Bitner, Michael T. Solomon, Benedikt Tissot, Guido Burkard, Alan M. Dibos, Jiefei Zhang, F. Joseph Heremans, David D. Awschalom
arxiv-2405-16303.description: Abstract Optically interfaced solid-state defects are promising candidates for quantum communication technologies. The ideal defect system would feature bright telecom emission, long-lived spin states, and a scalable material platform, simultaneously. Here, we employ one such system, vanadium ( V 4 + V^{4+} ) in silicon carbide (SiC), to establish a potential telecom spin-photon interface within a mature semiconductor host.

arxiv-2406-09191.title: Comprehensive Machine Learning Model Comparison for Cherenkov and Scintillation Light Separation due to Particle Interactions Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2406-09191.creator: Emrah Tiras, Merve Tas, Dilara Kizilkaya, Muhammet Anil Yagiz, Mustafa Kandemir
arxiv-2406-09191.description: Abstract The demand for novel detector mediums such as Water-based Liquid Scintillator (WbLS) has increased over the last few decades due to their capability for both low energy particle interactions and higher light yield. Recently, the usage of machine learning (ML) methods in high-energy physics has also been increasing.

arxiv-2506-00988.title: LensCraft: Your Professional Virtual Cinematographer
arxiv-2506-00988.creator: Zahra Dehghanian, Morteza Abolghasemi, Hossein Azizinaghsh, Amir Vahedi, Hamid Beigy, Hamid R. Rabiee
arxiv-2506-00988.description: Abstract Digital creators, from indie filmmakers to animation studios, face a persistent bottleneck: translating their creative vision into precise camera movements. Despite significant progress in computer vision and artificial intelligence, current automated filming systems struggle with a fundamental trade-off between mechanical execution and creative intent.

arxiv-2507-05599.title: How Easy Is It to Learn Motion Models from Widefield Fluorescence Single Particle Tracks?
arxiv-2507-05599.creator: Zachary H. Hendrix, Lance W.Q. Xu (徐伟青), Steve Pressé
arxiv-2507-05599.description: Abstract Motion models ( i.e. , transition probability densities) are often deduced from fluorescence widefield tracking experiments by analyzing single-particle trajectories post-processed from data. This analysis immediately raises the question: To what degree is our ability to learn motion models impacted by analyzing post-processed trajectories versus raw measurements?

pmc-11344824.title: A scoping review of large language model based approaches for information extraction from radiology reports
pmc-11344824.creator: Daniel Reichenpfader, Henning Müller, Kerstin Denecke
pmc-11344824.description: Radiological imaging is a globally prevalent diagnostic method, yet the free text contained in radiology reports is not frequently used for secondary purposes. Natural Language Processing can provide structured data retrieved from these reports. This paper provides a summary of the current state of research on Large Language Model (LLM) based approaches for information extraction (IE) from radiology reports.

pmc-11379745.title: Determination of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in indoor work environments by solid phase microextraction-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry
pmc-11379745.creator: Wadir Mario Valentino Marchesiello, Giuseppina Spadaccino, Muhammad Usman, Donatella Nardiello, Maurizio Quinto
pmc-11379745.description: Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are continuously emitted into the atmosphere from natural and anthropogenic sources and rapidly spread from the atmosphere to different environments. A large group of VOCs has been included in the class of air pollutants; therefore, their determination and monitoring using reliable and sensitive analytical methods represents a key aspect of health risk assessment.

pmc-11509371.title: Reverse Design of Pixel-Type Micro-Polarizer Arrays to Improve Polarization Image Contrast
pmc-11509371.creator: Yonggui Shi, Zhihai Lin, Tianran Wang, Chaokai Huang, Hui Chen, Jianxiong Chen, Yu Xie, Jiang Guo, Zhenzhong Wang, Yebing Tian, Jianguo Zhang
pmc-11509371.description: Micro-polarizer array (MPA) is the core optical component of the Division of Focal-Plane (DoFP) imaging system, and its design is very important to the system’s performance. Traditional design methods rely on theoretical analysis and simulation, which is complicated and requires designers to have profound theoretical foundations.

pmc-11655304.title: First aid treatment and airway management for chemical burns combined with inhalation injury: A case report
pmc-11655304.creator: Yaxin Shen, Liming Fu, Zhicheng Yue, Weiliang Shi, Chunyan Li, Chunjuan Zhang
pmc-11655304.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chemical burns account for a small percentage of burn patients, and there are even fewer burn patients suffering from chemical burns combined with inhalation injury. As chemical substances corrode the airway, which leads to persistent necrotic shedding of the respiratory mucosa and scarring contracture as the airway heals, a proportion of patients develop airway stenosis, requiring more aggressive treatment or even surgery.

pmc-12478696.title: DeepEPI: CNN-transformer-based model for extracting TF interactions through predicting enhancer-promoter interactions
pmc-12478696.creator: Seyedeh Fatemeh Tabatabaei, Saeedeh Akbari Roknabadi, Somayyeh Koohi, Mariike Kuijjer
pmc-12478696.description: MotivationWe introduce DeepEPI, a deep learning framework for studying enhancer–promoter interactions (EPIs) directly from genomic sequences. By integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with Transformer blocks, DeepEPI captures the complex regulatory interplay between enhancers and promoters, a key factor in gene expression and disease mechanisms.

pmc-12597960.title: Dynamic coding network for robust fruit detection in low-visibility agricultural scenes
pmc-12597960.creator: Hanyun Lu, Teng Jin, Chen Wan, Shuifa Sun, Xiumei Zhou, Fangyi Wang
pmc-12597960.description: IntroductionAccurate fruit detection under low-visibility conditions such as fog, rain, and low illumination is crucial for intelligent orchard management and robotic harvesting. However, most existing detection models experience significant performance degradation in these visually challenging environments.MethodsThis study proposes a modular detection framework named Dynamic Coding Network (DCNet), designed specifically for robust fruit detection in low-visibility agricultural scenes.

pmc-12630889.title: Effects of Pisha sandstone application rate and microbial agents on soil nutrient dynamics and microbial characteristics in sandy soil
pmc-12630889.creator: Zhishui Liang, Xiuwen Fang, Haiying Gao, Bo Pan, Jishu Zhang
pmc-12630889.description: Sandy soils are characterized by rapid water loss, low nutrient availability, poor vegetation establishment, and high susceptibility to wind erosion. Although Pisha sandstone has been recognized as an effective amendment to improve the physical stability of sandy soils, its role in enhancing soil fertility and biological functioning—particularly when combined with microbial inoculants—remains poorly understood.

pmc-12656005.title: Stable and High-Performance Polyaniline/V2CTx MXene Composite Electrochromic Films Prepared by One-Pot Electrodeposition Method
pmc-12656005.creator: Dan Zhou, Qihuang Deng, Liping Yang, Tsuyoshi Michinobu
pmc-12656005.description: In order to improve the electrochromic performance of polyaniline (PANI), porous PANI/vanadium carbide MXene (PANI/V2CTx) composite electrochromic films were prepared via a rapid, facile, and low-cost one-pot electrodeposition method from an aqueous solution composed of aniline and V2CTx for the first time.

pmc-13014541.title: Preoperative sarcopenia and its impact on postoperative complications in laparoscopic anti-reflux surgery: a clinical analysis
pmc-13014541.creator: Zhong-Yu Wang, Yu Liu, Jie Lin, Fan-Ke Wang, Hong-Fei Pang, Yu-Hang Liu, Ming Wei, Yuan-Yuan Wang
pmc-13014541.description: BackgroundTo investigate the influence of sarcopenia on postoperative outcomes in gastroesophageal reflux disease patients undergoing concomitant laparoscopic hiatal hernia repair and laparoscopic fundoplication.MethodsRetrospective analysis was conducted on 69 patients who underwent laparoscopic hiatal hernia repair combined with laparoscopic fundoplication in the Department of Gastroenterology at the First Hospital of Hebei Medical University from September 2024 to May 2025.

pmc-13185900.title: 3D quantitative MRI for cognitive performance: T1 relaxation times of the right putamen and volumes of the left hippocampus as key biomarkers
pmc-13185900.creator: Lora Kovacheva, Jan R Schüre, Svenja Klinsing, Rafael Willems, Mario Balo, Ralf Deichmann, Elke Hattingen, Christophe T Arendt
pmc-13185900.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) represents anearly stage of cognitive decline, often preceding dementia. While hippocampal atrophy is a recognized imaging marker, the role of deep gray matter structures and tissue alterations remains less understood.

pmc-13559893.title: High out-of-plane piezoelectric response in Janus SeWZH (Z = N, P, As) semiconductors: a first-principles prediction
pmc-13559893.creator: A. I. Kartamyshev, Vo Q. Nha, Le D. Hieu, Tuan V. Vu, Pham T. Truong, Huynh V. Phuc, Nguyen T. Hiep
pmc-13559893.description: A systematic first-principles investigation has been conducted to explore the fundamental properties of Janus SeWZH (Z = N, P, As) monolayers. Cohesive-energy calculations, phonon-dispersion analysis, and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations consistently verify the energetic, dynamical, and thermal stabilities of the proposed SeWNH, SeWPH, and SeWAsH monolayers, indicating their potential feasibility for experimental synthesis.

pmc-13560880.title: Distinct endogenous retroviruses are expressed in mutational subtypes of clear cell renal cell carcinoma and are linked to improved clinical outcomes
pmc-13560880.creator: Kevin Meli, Cora A. Ricker, Sabrina Y. Camp, Katrine Madsen, Hanna Soulati, Christof C. Smith, Chris Labaki, Eddy Saad, Jennifer A. Karlow, Brendan Reardon, Jihye Park, Natalie I. Vokes, David A. Schoenfeld, Kathleen H. Burns, Benjamin G. Vincent, Toni K. Choueiri, David A. Braun, Eliezer M. Van All
pmc-13560880.description: SUMMARYDistinct mutations in chromatin regulators and aberrant expression of transposable elements (TEs), have been associated with clinical benefit to immunotherapy (IO) in specific clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) clinical contexts. However, the relationship between mutations in chromatin regulators and TE expression, and their effect on clinical outcomes, are incompletely understood.
